settings.title: Signing in
settings.intro: Saving reloads the SSH server. The settings apply to new sign-ins; open sessions stay open.
settings.passwordsHint: Off: only keys work, which stops password guessing.
settings.rootHint: Whether root may sign in over SSH, and how.
settings.passwordsOffText: Only keys will work. Make sure you can log in with a key before you continue, or you may lock yourself out.

port.intro: Moving SSH keeps the old port open for a while, so you can check the new one first.
port.current: SSH listens on port {ports}. | SSH listens on ports {ports}.
port.inProgress: A move is in progress; finish or cancel it in the banner above.

steps.listen: Listen on port {port} as well; the old port keeps working
steps.selinux: On systems with SELinux, allow SSH on the new port
steps.check: Check that SSH answers on port {port}
steps.close: Close port {old} after {minutes} minutes if someone has connected to port {port} from another host by then, or earlier when you close it

port.title: Move SSH to port {port}?
port.text: SSH will listen on both the old and the new port. Log in on the new port to check it works (and open it in your cloud provider's security group). The old port closes after {minutes} minutes once a connection from another host has reached the new port, or when you close it; with no such connection it stays open.
port.pendingText: SSH listens on port {old} and on the new port {port}. Log in on port {port} to check it works, and open it in your cloud provider's security group if there is one.
port.pendingReached: SSH listens on port {old} and on the new port {port}. A connection from another host has reached port {port}.
port.closesInIfReached: The old port closes in {time} if the new port is reached from outside by then
port.held: The old port was kept open
port.heldUnreached: The time ran out, but nobody had connected to port {port} from another host, so port {old} was kept open: a security group or firewall in front of this server may still block port {port}. Log in on port {port}, then close the old port here, or cancel the move.
port.heldReached: The time ran out before anyone had connected to port {port} from another host, so port {old} was kept open. A connection has reached port {port} since: close the old port here, or cancel the move.
port.heldNotListening: The time ran out, but SSH did not answer on port {port}, so port {old} was kept open. Check the SSH server, then close the old port here, or cancel the move.
port.finishText: Only port {port} stays open. Make sure you have logged in on it.

keys.label: Authorized keys of {user}
keys.emptyText: Add a public key to let its owner sign in as this user without a password.
keys.noUsers: No user who can sign in was found
keys.addIntro: Paste one public key, as in the .pub file. Ed25519, ECDSA, FIDO and RSA keys of at least 2048 bits are accepted.
keys.keyHint: One line starting with its type, such as ssh-ed25519.

steps.mode: Keep the file owned by the user, readable by them only

keys.deleteText: The key {fingerprint} can no longer log in as {user}.
keys.rootReadOnly: Root's keys cannot be changed while root access is turned off in the settings.
